verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents ongoing monitoring of connected systems: AWS resources (accounts, RDS, load balancers, IAM users), GitHub configuration, user access and Dependabot alerts, Google Workspace users and Gmail settings, and MDM device posture. It also runs daily code scans and Fieldwork evidence collection on a schedule. However, the evidence never describes automated control tests with a stated cadence, or failing controls being surfaced or alerted within hours. Missing for 10: documented automated control-test engine mapped to compliance controls, monitoring frequency for cloud/SaaS integrations, alerting on failing controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
